basic_details.job_title: CUSAT Technician Grade II Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 2 Posts
basic_details.short_information: Cochin University of Science and Technology (CUSAT) has notified 2 vacancies for the Technician Grade II post on a contract basis under advertisement number Ad.G4/SOE/Mechanical.E/T.S(con)/2022. Candidates applying for this position require an ITI Machinist qualification along with 3 years of experience, and the assigned pay is Rs. 25,980. The appointment is for a tenure of 1 year with a break during May-June vacation months, extendable up to 2 years. Eligible applicants must apply online and submit the signed hard copy of the uploaded form along with required proofs by post or in person on or

how_to_apply: Apply online through the Cochin University of Science and Technology website at recruit.cusat.ac.in on or before 30.10.2026.
Submit a separate application with the prescribed fee online for each post having a separate serial number.
Take a printout of the signed hard copy of the uploaded form and attach proof of age, educational qualification, experience, and community.
Send or deliver the hard copy to the "Registrar, Administrative Office, Cochin University of Science and Technology, Kochi - 22" on or before 06.11.2026.
Superscribe the envelope with "Application for the post of Technician Grade II in the division of Mechanical Engineering in the School of Engineering on contract basis".

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The consolidated pay is ₹25,980/- per month. The appointment is on a contract basis for a period of 1 (one) year with a break during May-June vacation months, and is extendable up to 2 years. Reservation rules are applicable.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for CUSAT Technician Grade II
content_sections.text: Apply online through the Cochin University of Science and Technology website at recruit.cusat.ac.in on or before 30.10.2026. Submit a separate application with the prescribed fee online for each post having a separate serial number. Take a printout of the signed hard copy of the uploaded form and attach proof of age, educational qualification, experience, and community. Send or deliver the hard copy to the "Registrar, Administrative Office, Cochin University of Science and Technology, Kochi - 22" on or before 06.11.2026. Superscribe the envelope with "Application for the post of Technician Grade II in the division of Mechanical Engineering in the School of Engineering on contract basis".

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Reservation rules are applicable for the appointment. All proceedings are subject to the result of writ petitions or writ appeals pending before the Hon'ble High Court of Kerala.

faq.question: Q1. Is the Technician Grade II post permanent or on contract?
faq.answer: The appointment is on a contract basis for a period of 1 year with a break during May-June vacation months, and it is extendable up to 2 years.

faq.question: Q2. Who is eligible for age relaxation?
faq.answer: Usual age relaxation is applicable as per Government Rules and Regulations for eligible categories, with the age limit set between 18 to 40 years as on 01.01.2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application fee for SC/ST candidates?
faq.answer: The application fee is ₹195/- for SC/ST candidates, while it is ₹950/- for General and OBC candidates.

faq.question: Q4. What documents must be sent with the hard copy of the application?
faq.answer: Candidates must send proof of age, educational qualification, experience, and community along with the signed hard copy of the uploaded form.
